description: This file contains test cases for the model selection display utility functions using the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions that resolve model display references, names, and session info model selections.

methods.name: resolveModelDisplayRef
methods.description: Resolves a model display reference string based on various model id components.

methods.name: resolveModelDisplayName
methods.description: Generates a display name for a model, typically a simplified or abbreviated label.

methods.name: resolveSessionInfoModelSelection
methods.description: Determines the session's model provider and model based on current, override, and entry data.
